dishes.name: Smørrebrød
dishes.desc: Open rye sandwiches with herring, shrimp, egg or roast beef. Copenhagen's lunch places have kept the form alive for over a century.

dishes.name: Wienerbrød
dishes.desc: Laminated butter pastry with custard or remonce. The Danish pastry as eaten in Copenhagen bakeries.

dishes.name: Stjerneskud
dishes.desc: Fried and steamed plaice on buttered bread, topped with shrimp and caviar. A classic Copenhagen restaurant dish.

dishes.name: Danish hot dog
dishes.desc: Red sausage in a bun with remoulade and crispy onions, sold from pølsevogne across the city.

dishes.name: Flæskesteg
dishes.desc: Roast pork with crackling, red cabbage and brown potatoes. A Danish staple on old Copenhagen menus.

dishes.name: Bornholm smoked herring
dishes.desc: Herring smoked in alder smokehouses on Bornholm, served with raw egg yolk and radish. Sold at the island's smokehouses.
